commits.subject: Add local diagnostic ZIP saves to the TUI (#60542)
commits.reason: Allow an explicitly requested local diagnostic ZIP independently of uploads. Keep ALab feedback.enabled=false: Enter cannot send when uploads are disabled, Ctrl-S chooses LocalZip, log/history attachments require separate consent, and an unavailable save never falls back to upload. Dispatch rechecks the active connection and refuses local saves on remote workspaces; Cloud feedback is unavailable. Staging is bounded and cleaned, save paths belong to the app-server Codex home, local saves avoid future rollout-path attachments and use thread-ID selection. Source and meaningful regressions reviewed; native feedback/save/no-upload scenarios remain pending.

Also retain correct interrupted-turn pagination: only a loaded owning page emits terminal notices, including itemless interruptions, without manufacturing successful completion. commits.reason: Keep consecutive invocation grouping behind default-off collapse_turn_details. commits.subject: Collapse completed turn activity beneath transcript prompts (#60557)
commits.reason: Retain default-off completed-turn collapse on the owned transcript. Carry authoritative assistant message phase through live consolidation and replay; only a completed-turn boundary plus a final answer folds preceding commentary/tools under its prompt. Partial/final answers stay visible, unfinished legacy progress remains until an answer, and nested tool groups expand separately. Untimed completion markers can acquire later timing without duplication; terminal mode still omits untimed display. Controls are presentation-only zero-width source ranges, preserve wrapped-prompt anchoring and search matches, and detailed/disabled views retain original output. Source and meaningful regressions reviewed; native phase/collapse/realtime scenarios remain pending.
